g.text: Descriptive endpoint means by fixed model and instruction
Original primary cohort only: 896 attempts; 890 valid graphs; 6 terminal failures.
Numbers beside points: defined endpoints, out of eight attempts per model-condition. Failures excluded, not zero.
Global uses density; other methods use clustering. Separate endpoints are not a quality ranking; no inferential intervals here.
